# Checklist

- [ ] Branch name matches the PR document.
- [ ] Branch name matches `<type>/<slug>`.
- [ ] File changes match the PR file allowlist.
- [ ] PR title matches `<type>(<scope>): <summary>`.
- [ ] All commit subjects match `<type>(<scope>)!: <summary>`, stay <= 72 chars, and use ASCII.
- [ ] `!` commits include `BREAKING CHANGE:`.
- [ ] scripts/check passes.
- [ ] CI required checks pass.
- [ ] Evidence pointers are listed for activated invariants.
- [ ] Simulated role reviews are complete.
